mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market weakness that may trigger central bank intervention, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output above 105 (INDPRO) signals robust supply chain activity supporting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1100 indicates strong residential construction activity supporting consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1100.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.25% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 0.25%) reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25%.
